description: Read one agent skill by its id, as returned by mba_list_agent_skills or mba_create_agent_skill.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_agent_skill

channel.description: The channel/platform this skill applies to. Known values: email, instagram, line, messenger, sms, tiktok, unknown, webchat, whatsapp.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the skill was created

description.description: A description telling the AI when to apply this skill

id.description: A unique identifier for the skill

metadata.description: A map of key-value pairs for additional metadata

skill.description: The body containing the actual instructions for the AI. Has no specific restrictions on structure or content.

title.description: An optional, human-readable name for the skill

title: Read an agent skill
